prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a stack of paperwork and forms scattered across a wooden desk, with the focus on a detailed surfboard order sheet. The central document features hand-drawn outlines of a surfboard from the top and bottom views, surrounded by handwritten notes, measurements, and specifications. The forms are printed on white and yellow paper, some overlapping, with bold black signatures and official stamps visible. The lighting is soft and natural, casting gentle shadows and giving the scene a warm, slightly muted tone. The composition is intimate and documentary-style, with a shallow depth of field that blurs the background and edges, drawing attention to the intricate details and textures of the paper. The overall mood is one of quiet concentration and craftsmanship, evoking the behind-the-scenes process of custom surfboard design.
